          About this item

          • Apple Find My Compatible (iOS Only):ZIMCORE tracker tags work seamlessly with Apple's Find My app. No additional app, SIM card, or subscription required. Easily add your item locator in seconds and track keys, luggage,and more directly from your iPhone or iPad
          • Find Nearby,Find Far Away:Use the Find My app to play a loud sound and quickly locate your key finder when it's nearby, or ask Siri for help. When out of Bluetooth range, millions of Apple devices securely update your item locator's location through the Find My network
          • Left Behind Alerts,Lost Mode :Receive notifications when your tracker tags are left behind and view the last known location in the Find My app. Enable Lost Mode so anyone who finds your item locator can securely contact you using your shared information
          • Share Items with Family:Easily share your tracker tags with family or trusted friends through the Find My app, making it simple for multiple users to locate shared car keys,kids,cats,dogs or other valuable belongings. Great for travel and everyday organization
          • Replaceable Battery and Water Resistant:Built with a 2 year replaceable CR2032 battery that provides up to one year of reliable performance. Water-resistant construction helps protect your key finder during everyday use,rain,travel,and outdoor activities

          Product description

          Seamless Integration with Apple Find My

          Reliable Tracking with Privacy Protection

          Enjoy secure location tracking with end-to-end encryption to help protect your privacy. The replaceable battery provides over 2 years of reliable performance, reducing maintenance while keeping your important belongings easy to find whenever you need them.

          Lost Mode Helps You Find What Matters Most

          Never Leave Your Essentials Behind

          Receive instant left-behind alerts on your iPhone when your tracker is separated from you. Whether you've forgotten your keys, wallet, backpack, or luggage, you'll be notified in time so you can return before your belongings are too far away.

          Built for Everyday Adventures

          Water-Resistant, Dustproof & Built to Last

          Engineered for reliable performance in everyday conditions, the tracker withstands rain, splashes, and dust with ease. Whether attached to your keys, backpack, luggage, or pet accessories, it delivers dependable protection for long-lasting use.

          Loud Sound, Faster Recovery

          Powerful 100dB Alarm for Easy Location

          The built-in buzzer delivers a loud sound of up to 100dB, making it easy to hear your tracker even in cluttered or hard-to-reach places. With a Bluetooth range of up to 200 ft (60 m), you can quickly locate your essentials at home, in the office, or on the go.

          Share Tracking with Family and Friends

          MFi Certified for Reliable Apple Compatibility

          Officially Apple MFi Certified and fully compatible with the Apple Find My network, the tracker delivers reliable performance and seamless integration with your Apple devices. Track your valuables confidently wherever your journey takes you.

          Versatile Tracking for Every Part of Your Life

          Perfect for Home, Travel, Work, and More

          From keys and wallets to luggage, backpacks, cameras, bicycles, and pet accessories, this tracker is built to protect the items you rely on every day. One compact device helps keep all your essentials easy to locate.

          Trusted by Customers Around the World

          Trusted Performance. Everyday Confidence.

          Q:Does it work with Android?

          A:No. This tracker works exclusively with Apple's Find My network and is compatible only with iOS devices.

          Q: Do I need to recharge the tracker every few days?

          A: No recharging is required. The tracker is powered by a standard, easily replaceable CR2032 coin battery. Provides over 1 year of continuous battery life before needing a replacement.

          Q: Do I need to pay a monthly subscription fee or buy a SIM card?

          A: No! Unlike traditional car GPS trackers, this device requires absolutely ZERO monthly fees, NO subscriptions, and NO SIM card.

          Q:Does it have a loud alarm?

          A:Yes. The tracker includes a built-in speaker that can play a sound through the Find My app to help you locate nearby items.

          Q: Can I mount this outside my vehicle, and is it waterproof?

          A: Yes! The package includes a heavy-duty, water-resistant magnetic case. The strong magnets firmly attach to the metal surfaces of your car or truck, and the waterproof design ensures it stays secure and protected during daily driving and various weather conditions.
